panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since MongoDB last started.

panels.title: Connections in use
panels.description: Client connections open right now.

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: Resident memory of the mongod process.

panels.title: Cache in use
panels.description: WiredTiger cache currently holding data.

panels.title: Looma data size
panels.description: Size of the looma database, uncompressed.

targets.query: event.module:mongodb AND metricset.name:dbstats AND box_name.keyword:"$box" AND mongodb.dbstats.db.keyword:looma

panels.title: Requests per minute
panels.description: Network requests MongoDB received in the last minute.

panels.title: Operations per minute
panels.description: Operations by type. Counters reset to 0 when MongoDB restarts.

panels.title: Documents per minute
panels.description: Documents returned to clients and written.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Client connections open.

panels.title: Network per minute
panels.description: Bytes received from and sent to clients.

panels.title: Average operation time
panels.description: Average time MongoDB took per operation in each minute.

panels.title: Documents scanned vs returned
panels.description: A scanned line far above returned means queries read many documents to find few, usually a missing index.

panels.title: Operations waiting on locks
panels.description: Operations queued for a lock. Above 0 for long means MongoDB is overloaded.

panels.title: Page faults per minute
panels.description: Times MongoDB had to read from disk because the data was not in memory.

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: Resident memory of the mongod process.

panels.title: Cache: used vs limit
panels.description: WiredTiger cache in use against its limit.

panels.title: Asserts per minute
panels.description: Internal checks that failed. User asserts are usually harmless, such as a bad command; regular and warning deserve a look.

panels.title: Write conflicts per minute
panels.description: Writes that had to retry because another write touched the same document.

panels.title: Data size by database
panels.description: Uncompressed size of the data in each database.

panels.title: Index size by database
panels.description: Size of the indexes in each database.

panels.title: Databases
panels.description: Highest value of each database in the selected time range.
